summary: IQVIA Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing that wholly owned subsidiary IQVIA Inc. priced $2.0 billion of senior notes due 2034 at 6.375% per annum under an executed purchase agreement. Proceeds will fully redeem the Issuer's 5.000% senior notes due 2026, repay a portion of revolver borrowings, and cover fees and expenses; closing is expected on or about September 23, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch Treasury-rate sensitivity and any rating or leverage commentary.
